title: North City Studio- 5mi to Downtown/Nissan Stadium!
description:
Cozy studio 5 miles from downtown! Stay at North City Studio for easy access to central Nashville! Go downtown for your get down before relaxing in a super comfy memory foam bed and dream of your boot stomping adventures!

Welcome Production buddies, we are located 1 mile from the new Rock Nashville!

Booking guest must be 21+ per Nashville codes.
Permit #2021027377

North City Studio is a safe space for any and all people regardless of race, creed, sexual orientation or disability.

The space
Modern and comfy - North City Studio is a private studio located on the ground level floor of our property with its own private entrance and bathroom **CONNECTED TO OUR HOUSE** Driveway parking (1 spot plus plenty of street parking) and access to our backyard and fire pit are included.

Guest access
Self check-in is easy at whatever time is convenient to you via your private hidden gated door and lightning is kept on to make access easy.  We do not allow extra guests beyond our 2 guest capacity (even for visits) unless approved by the host.

Other things to note
The studio is equipped HVAC which is fully temperature controllable in the space!

The studio includes one standard size bed and one sofa bed.

host_details:
Hey I'm Gretchen. I love traveling and using Airbnb to explore neighborhoods I wouldn't usually have been in and get a real feel of the area I'm staying in.  I have lived in Nashville for 20 years and know my away around things pretty well if you have any questions. I used to work in live production in music city and my husband Dave currently tours with country music artists.  I love living in Nashville because there is always something to do and there is so much beautiful nature surrounding, with endless hiking trails, rivers and greenways to explore. I live above North City Studio in my house with my husband and daughter.  We also have a dog named Pepper living with us. She loves everyone.
